text: A woman with long, flowing red hair sits cross-legged on a stone floor. She has fair skin, orange eyes, and a slender build. Wearing a white draped garment tied at the waist, she accessorizes with a blue beaded necklace and bracelets. Her pose is relaxed, one hand resting near her knee, the other touching glowing red runes before her. Behind her, dark Gothic arches frame ornate circular carvings. The scene suggests an ancient, mystical interior.
